qa/evidence-proof-3.txt (proof 3): reopen shasum -a 256 printed 3ecb03eca8b39cb1497b7f32f9b2b553729fd824a5b0ec11d0e222e5bf20c5a4 for charter/SPEC.md and 314220fea9a84fa266c3b6c295bde41210c0d5d3fa90cc6436278dfb29cf6ec7 for the schema; C init --refresh-spec in QA/scratch exit 0 printing already this binary's spec for charter/SPEC.md and kept for charter/GOVERNANCE.md and for the schema, git status --porcelain empty. Mutant, git show 363be85:charter/SPEC.md over the file -> first sum differs (the contract's 7479871a... value) and check --strict prints a line containing earlier published spec (RED); check exits 0 and only warns there, which is exactly what the contract claims - no exit-1 claim is made; restored with git checkout, not init --refresh-spec. Vacuity: at base 363be85 the shasum prints the two older sums -> fails; init --refresh-spec was not run in QA/base because the task restricts it to QA/scratch, and its already-this-binary criterion cannot hold at base since base carries the older spec text (the base check warning quotes it). Evidence file sha256 c28b19cf25e415be9ae22cd0b35155ce2d54fc6b3f2dcae1d9fb5debb650a845.

qa/evidence-proof-4.txt (proof 4): reopen in the slice checkout, C hooks status exit 0 naming the literal path of C for pre-commit and for pre-push and ending charter: hooks status: match; git status --porcelain in the checkout after was empty (nothing written). qa/evidence-proof-7.txt (proof 7): every reopen green. In QA/scratch git diff --numstat 363be85 efece0f8 over ci.yml printed one line starting 1 TAB 1; git diff --name-only listed exactly the seven files the contract names. In the checkout: pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.campaign.json --noEmit exit 0; pnpm run audit:public exit 0 printing prospective package public-safety: PASS (62 files) under bun 1.4.0; the vitest inspection test exit 0 with 1 passed, 15 skipped. The checkout's git status --porcelain stayed empty throughout. Mutants n/a (regression set). At base the two diff reopens list nothing rather than the named results, so they cannot pass there. Evidence file sha256 da2dba9b66b3bf42c4c9b306e03991c4b8a3940cb7b3bd39fd2d77b6a6e47108.

qa/review.md (review of git -C QA/scratch diff 363be85 efece0f8, seven files, 71 insertions, 10 deletions): (1) no proof is vacuous - reopens of proofs 1, 2 and 3 were executed in QA/base at 363be85 and each fails there on every criterion; proof 3's init was not run in base because the task restricts init --refresh-spec to QA/scratch, and its criterion cannot hold at base regardless. (2) no reopen reads a file another repository can rewrite: every read is in-tree except the charter binary at its literal path (allowed), this repository's own common git directory hooks (proof 4's declared subject), gh/bun/pnpm tool config outside every repository, and charter's pin table, which is outside every git repository and whose content was shown not to affect proof 1's verdict (with a table carrying no current rows, check --strict still exits 0 with the required substring and charter: ok). (3) a shell is named for every reopen and mutant by the paragraph headed Shell, all mutants and the gh reopen were executed under exactly it, and the hosted-CI claim is true of .github/workflows/ci.yml: no defaults block, the tsc step has no shell: line, and GitHub's default for a step with no shell: line is bash -e {0}; the three proof-7 commands contain no pipe. (4) no tracked file outside charter/ and qa/ names 98055d7, the older spec or schema hashes, or even the string charter/SPEC. (5) proof 4 is stated with its scope - hooks outside the frozen tree in this repository's common git directory, reopen in the slice worktree, mutant in a hookless fresh clone - so a reader can tell what it shows and what it does not. (6) the paragraph headed Order of commits is true: log 363be85..efece0f8 is DONE list, dispatch record, re-pin, then the freeze record commit; e2874c3 and 02171e4 both carry the 98055d7 PIN line; the change commit touches only the four re-pin files; the build/hooks attribution clauses leave no mark in git - unverifiable, not contradicted, with today's hooks matching the c6c9843 build. (7) scope is stated honestly: every Change claim verified, out-of-scope items each confirmed (no src/ file, charter job red as NOT CHECKED, seat_evidence unset), budgets consistent with charter.toml (repair cycles 1 and review families 2 match; QA attempts 2 is the slice-level declaration every recent accepted DONE uses under the cap of 3), Base main 363be85 consistent with dispatch.base_commit e2874c3 under the house convention of the dispatch record's own parent, and the pin-notes order claim matches the charter pin notes. Records: freeze record commit names the frozen head, 575 entries = 593 tracked files minus the 18 freeze records of other slices, four spot re-hashes matched; gate --verify confirmed this slice's DONE hash against the dispatch record. Zero new defects found. Evidence file sha256 2cffb00675d0a49c31953c98e7a54a7b704a0467f383c2546cbd62bfe3302f33.

notes.process: QA/scratch is a shared clone at the frozen head efece0f8f2ed233f815dd12397e06af5d70276fe and QA/base a shared clone at 363be85; both are left in place for the PM to remove. Every mutant was applied only in QA/scratch and restored with git checkout -- <file>, with git status --porcelain empty after each; the slice checkout was never edited and its status stayed empty. Only charter check --strict, charter init --refresh-spec (QA/scratch only), charter hooks status, charter gate <slice> --verify and charter receipt on this receipt were run - no gate --dispatch or --accept, no freeze, no reopen, no hooks install, no cargo. pnpm, tsc, audit:public and vitest ran in the checkout; everything else in QA/scratch, each under bash --noprofile --norc -e -o pipefail -c with nice -n 10 timeout 900. Bun from ~/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/1.4.0/bin, version 1.4.0. Home paths written as ~; no personal data recorded. Provisioning record qa/evidence-0.txt, sha256 0d7a45908858027bd66e172ee3c5ffd1dc6ed8bb2353eef61fe925b143271345.

notes.proof6_baseline: Run 43980869590 concludes failure at run level solely because the non-required charter job fails as NOT CHECKED at its probe step (charter source unreachable from this runner) - the declared baseline; verify is success.
notes.freeze_coverage: The freeze record covers 575 of the 593 files tracked at the frozen head; the 18 omitted are exactly the charter/.freeze records of other slices (nine freeze records and nine reopen records), charter's selector behaviour as recorded in the mg-charter-spec-refresh receipt. Four spot re-hashes (ci.yml, PIN.toml, SPEC.md, schema) matched the record byte-for-byte, and the SPEC.md/schema values are the contract's two new sums.
notes.proof3_mutant_note: Under the SPEC.md mutant, charter check --strict exits 0 and only warns; the contract claims only the differing sum plus the earlier published spec line, both observed, so RED rests on the reopen's own shasum criterion - exactly as the DONE words it.

With CHARTER_PINS pointed at a table carrying no current rows it still exited 0 with the required substring and charter: ok, so proof 1's verdict does not depend on that file's content.
